author: Y Combinator
description:
In this episode of "How to Build the Future," Max Hodak, co-founder of Neuralink and founder of Science, discusses groundbreaking advances in brain-computer interface technology (BCI) that are allowing blind patients to have vision. 

Chapters:

00:00 - Intro
04:00 - Retinal implant technology and clinical trials
08:00 - Brain plasticity, consciousness and perception
12:00 - Future technology, neural engineering and drug discovery
16:00 - Medical device trials and eye disease landscape
20:00 - Retina anatomy, stimulation methods and optogenetics
24:00 - Bio‑hybrid approaches, stem‑cell neurons and company origins
28:00 - Take‑off era, industrial revolution and future tech pace
32:00 - Neural representations, latent space and AI parallels
36:00 - Early BCI history, Neuralink origins and motor decoding
40:00 - Medical ethics, ECMO case and perfusion technology
44:00 - Longevity outlook, the future of BCI
48:00 - Outro
